concept.what: Kenshi paints the Klein face — the HUD backdrop that melts the veil
concept.klein_face: The inside-out donut (paper 89) — broadcast antenna — everything visible
concept.backdrop: Kenshi's sword-punk desert atmosphere AS the visual layer behind all HUD data
concept.rtx: Ray-traced shadows cast THROUGH the data, creating depth and presence
concept.veil: The metagram layer becomes visible when the backdrop gives it contrast
concept.goal: Make OSINT (the outer world) WANT to visit primals.eco

L0_backdrop.aesthetic: Sword-punk desert, two moons, ancient ruins, molten skies
L0_backdrop.mood: The loading screen Kevin showed — dark shores, red sky, broken spires

L1_klein_face.render: SVG/Canvas Klein bottle wireframe, slowly rotating
L1_klein_face.meaning: Inside = outside, the broadcast antenna, anti-secret
L1_klein_face.color: Purple/UV strings on the klein wireframe

L2_data.source: Live organism data — pulse, senses, metrics, gates
L2_data.render: Current HUD content overlaid on backdrop
L2_data.color: Green text/data (ground growing) on dark backdrop

L3_metagram.source: Moving invisible data — metagrams in hologram subspace
L3_metagram.render: Pink polka dots drifting through, particle system
L3_metagram.color: Pink perilverse dots, appearing and fading
L3_metagram.meaning: The cloud that fills the gaps — what you almost see

L4_trace.source: RTX ray-trace shadows through all layers
L4_trace.render: CSS shadows, depth-of-field, light cone from two moons
L4_trace.meaning: Trace back through the abandon to melt the veil

color_system.backdrop: Dark desert tones — blacks, deep reds, burnt orange (Kenshi palette)
color_system.green: Data text and static elements (ground growing)
color_system.gold: Highlights, Meitou grade items, important data

primals_eco_face.current: Text-heavy, clean, informative but no visual PULL
primals_eco_face.target: Kenshi atmosphere backdrop, Klein face overlay, living metagrams
primals_eco_face.effect: Visitors feel the WORLD before they read the data
primals_eco_face.osint_pull: Beautiful face → curiosity → exploration → understanding → want

implementation.step_1: Capture Kenshi screenshots from blueGate (game is running!)
implementation.step_2: Create CSS backdrop with parallax and blur
implementation.step_3: Add Klein bottle SVG/Canvas overlay (from bingocube.js fog)
implementation.step_5: Deploy to eastGate HUD when STATIC
implementation.step_6: Test from Vanadium (single blind blink test)

the_trace.abandon: First Empire ruins, Obedience pit, Cat-Lon's empty throne
the_trace.through: RTX shadows trace the light path backward through history
the_trace.melt: The veil between game and reality dissolves
the_trace.want: The outer world sees Gaia through Kenshi's face and wants in
